summary: CodeQL is the static analysis engine behind GitHub code scanning, which finds and remediates security issues in your code. We’ve recently released CodeQL 2.27.4 with query accuracy improvements across several languages, stronger security checks when you bundle or publish a pack, and corrections to query metadata.
takeaways: The new functionality in CodeQL 2.27.4 will also be included in the GitHub Enterprise Server (GHES) 3.24 release.

Rust We have reduced false positives in the rust/uncontrolled-allocation-size , rust/log-injection , and rust/cleartext-logging queries.
